question: An aeration basin of 800 m3 holds mixed liquor at 2400 mg/L. Each day, 40 m3 of waste sludge at 6000 mg/L is removed and 4000 m3 of effluent leaves at 15 mg/L suspended solids. What is the solids retention time, counting both solids loss routes? Round to 1 decimal place.

Complete nitrification that removes ammonia and leaves the blanket compact and dense
Dispersed growth caused by a sudden toxic discharge that killed all the filaments
